Description: Caster receives basic idea of item's purpose, if any
Detects power in an object, but not what realm or how much; caster may concentrate on a different object each round
Gives a general idea of the place of origin of an item
Detects if a curse is on an item
Gives the origins of an item's power
Gives details of where, when, and how the examined piece of rock was worked
Gives a vision of a significant event in the item's past
Gives significant details about an item's construction and purpose (not specific powers)

Caster gets a vision up to 1 hour per level into the past. The desired time can be set within ±30 min. The vision must be associated with an item or place. The vision can last up to 1 minute per level if the caster concentrates and remains inactive
Gives major abilities and powers of an item

Gives a vision of how someone died and an image of their killer. This spell must be cast within 24 hours of the death. In addition, this spell must be cast at the place of death or in the presence of the dead body
When cast just before a Past Vision spell, it allows caster to lock onto a specific event in an item's past, and then examine that event with a Past Vision
Gives a complete rundown on an item's construction, powers, and purpose (may be modified if an item is extremely powerful)
As Past Vision I, except time range is 1 day per level (with an error of ±1 hour) and the vision can last up to 10 minutes per level
As Past Vision I, except time range is 1 month/lvl (with an error of ±1 day) and the vision can last up to 1 hour per level
As Past Vision I, except time range is 1 year per level (with an error of ±1 week) and the vision can last up to 5 hours per level

As Past Vision I, except time range is 10 year per level (with an error of ±1 month) and vision can last up to 10 hours per level (each hour of the past event takes only 10 minutes real time). SPECIAL NOTES A "curse" is usually something that is detrimental and magical in nature (e.g., delivered from the Curses spell list). The GM may decide that the "curses" spells on this spell list apply only to magical curses. See Section 7.1.30. OPEN MENTALISM 4.1.6 DELVING
